record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly lower learning rate from 6e-4 to 4e-4 and increase dropout from 0.10 to 0.15. Smaller updates coupled with stronger regularization may improve generalization without increasing model capacity, following the regression at width 64. Retain width 48, six causal blocks, existing features, tying, scoring, readout, loss and Adam optimizer. Keep seed 42, epoch cap 200 and 200 batches per epoch; save one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly reduce learning rate to 4e-4 and increase dropout to 0.15. Smaller updates and stronger regularization may improve generalization while retaining width 48 and six causal blocks. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction remain compatible; features, scoring, readout, loss, seeds and training limits are preserved.
